title: Add authentication layer mapping IRC nicks to LICHEN identities (or anonymous gateway mode)
description: Implement an authentication layer that maps IRC nicks/hostmasks to LICHEN identities. Support two modes: (1) Authenticated mode where IRC users are mapped to specific LICHEN /128 identities based on configuration, with cryptographic verification where possible. (2) Anonymous gateway mode where IRC messages are relayed with a gateway-sourced identity clearly marked as bridge-originated. In both modes, preserve verified LICHEN native /128 origin metadata in a stable displayed form. Do not allow impersonation of arbitrary IRC accounts or LICHEN identities.
